text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

largeheadline.line1: When you are unwilling to compromise, the choice is easy. EasyFuse.

text.text: EasyFuse is a comprehensive super-elastic nitinol staple system designed to provide fast and easy fixation in high demand applications of the foot and ankle.

text_copy.text: EasyFuse is a comprehensive super-elastic nitinol staple system designed to provide fast and easy fixation in high demand applications of the foot and ankle. A variety of implant configurations are offered in compact, sterile implant packs along with a universal, single use instruments pack.

text.text: EasyFuse implants have been designed for maximum strength and resistance to failure or breakage. EasyFuse’s extra wide bridge, robust corners, sharp teeth, and high compressive strength all work together to deliver dynamic compression you can count on.

text_1688119477_copy.text: Extra wide staple bridge designed to distribute forces and provide consistent implant strength.

text_1169611873_copy.text: Universal, sterile packed instrumentation decreases surgical complexity and reduces OR material waste.

text_682825835_copy.text: Intuitively designed inserter provides confident deployment of implant while also allowing quick and easy implant reloading if desired.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
• Wide bridge construction with uniform cross-section is designed to resist internal torsional and bending forces as well as distribute forces across the implant.
  • Aggressive corner-chamfers designed to allow flush seating on bone and minimizes soft tissue irritation.
  • Recessed teeth designed to increase implantstrength in the corners, as well as enhance fixation.
Wide range of sizes for varying patient and surgical needs.
Universal staple inserter works with all EasyFuse implants.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Adjustable drill guide for speed and simplicity
